title: Can I MASTER Horde Chess?
summary: chess.com Horde Chess vs online humans (up to ~1700): White has 36 pawns and no king; Black has a normal army. White wins by checkmating Black, Black wins by capturing every white pawn/piece. Goal: win five games, this time playing both colours. He uses a 'brick wall' method with the pawns (never accept trades while a pawn has two defenders), loses a pawn chain in game 2 but stages his 'craziest comeback', and ends with 'Pawn Muncher 9000' as Black.
rules: Horde setup: White has 36 pawns (ranks 1-4 full plus pawns on b5,c5,f5,g5) and no king; Black has the standard army.
White pawns on rank 1 can move one square (they may make a double step only from rank 2, standard horde rule, inferred).
White wins by checkmating Black's king; Black wins by capturing all White pieces (stalemate otherwise a draw).
Pawns promote normally; promoted pieces still have no king to protect.
win_condition: White: checkmate; Black: eliminate the horde. Series goal: 5 wins.
visual_fx: Mass of white pawns; game counter 1-5.
current_impl_issues: Legacy base:Horde only lets the player be the horde ('You are 36 pawns'); the video plays both colours (games as Black munching pawns). Offer side choice.
evidence: SRT 0:00 'white starts with 36 pawns and no King white wins by checkmating black and black wins by taking all of White's pawns my goal is to win five games'; 0:10 'I actually get the black pieces'; 12:40 'craziest comeback... win game number two'; 13:10 '1,700 rated player'; 25:40 'Pawn muncher 9000'; 26:10 win game 5. Frames: horde ranks 1-4 + some on 5.
